scope: Pre-Ready design review; no implemented evaluator or product failure

original_findings.issue: Reference observed count and complete flag do not establish completeness of the projected target fact tuple. A complete reference with observed=10 and empty supplied facts currently permits membership_absent, although the relevant membership row might be omitted from the projection. Thus absence can become a false observed failure rather than unknown.
original_findings.requested_change: Freeze the governed target population and its completeness contract. One bounded option is a homogeneous target-entity/kind reference declaration whose complete projection requires len(facts)==observed and exact row indices; alternatively retain explicit bound projection-completeness evidence. Missing projection coverage must stay unknown, while genuine complete historical empty population may fail absence. Add independent omitted-row versus complete-empty controls.

original_findings.issue: No selected fact_kind is declared although both universe_membership and sector_membership are supported. A sector fact can satisfy a universe expectation with matching text, or valid simultaneous sector/universe rows can be incorrectly treated as overlapping membership.
original_findings.requested_change: Add a closed selected kind or make the declaration explicitly homogeneous and typed. Define how irrelevant kinds are rejected or excluded before overlap/knowledge evaluation, and test identical-text cross-kind and simultaneous sector/universe cases.

original_findings.issue: ReferenceDeclaration explicitly matches context namespace/entity, but MarketCheck does not require supplied session namespace/session_id to match DecisionContext namespace/entity.session_id. Matching numeric bounds from a foreign session could pass the declared selected observation.
original_findings.requested_change: Require exact session namespace/session identity binding, with inconsistent_binding on contradiction; add independently expected foreign-namespace/session controls.

original_findings.issue: Counts are promised exact but decisive supported comparison and missing condition categories are not enumerated. Examples with null ContextCheck, membership missing reference plus missing history/text, or RevisionCheck missing identity/start/knowledge admit multiple reasonable counts and assessed values.
original_findings.requested_change: Freeze per-kind named condition categories, which conditions are evaluated when other operands are absent, assessed aggregation and unknown-count deduplication. Independent fixtures must bind these exact outputs, including failed-plus-unknown precedence.

additional_decisions: Clarify semantic request duplication: unique check_id alone permits repeated identical kind/subject checks under different IDs. Either reject repeated semantic identities or explicitly state counts are requested-check counts rather than deduplicated subjects; not_requested should use the fixed kind domain.

Precisely list all borrowed nested fields subject to string/count validation; current '256 governed identity items in any borrowed context if present' has no concrete applicable field in the selected DecisionContext/AvailabilitySpec and should be mapped or removed.

Retain the strict exact-declaration adjustment comparison label: unequal scales fail this selected exact-compatibility check even when accepted numeric contracts permit explicit exact conversion. Do not present that failure as universal economic incompatibility.

intermediate_findings.issue: Zero assessable facts produces unknown findings contradicts new assessed definition and failed-plus-missing precedence: future effective query with absent reference fails despite assessedFalse. Zero completed assessments alone must not override a visible violation.
intermediate_findings.requested_change: Restrict unknown conclusion to missing required proof with no observed violation, retaining exact failed-plus-unknown behavior.

intermediate_findings.location: Unique check IDs and denominator claim
intermediate_findings.issue: Different check IDs can repeat the same semantic kind/subject request, so unique IDs do not prevent semantic duplicate denominators as claimed.
intermediate_findings.requested_change: Freeze unique(kind,subject_id) or explicitly document counts as distinct requests and remove subject deduplication/replay claim.

intermediate_findings.issue: The selected DecisionContext/AvailabilitySpec has no declared governed-identity collection, leaving the bound without an exact field or measurable at/above test.
intermediate_findings.requested_change: Name the actual selected collection or remove this inapplicable bound; keep selected SessionSpec intervals and all nested labels explicitly bounded.

disposition: Corrected specification candidate; final independent readiness review remains required
corrections: Homogeneous explicit selected kind plus exact full projection cardinality/indices; omitted rows unknown, explicit complete empty distinct.
Exact per-kind missing categories, assessed iff zero unknown prerequisites, visible violations preserved with missing proof.
Semantic duplicates rejected, nested bounds explicit, exact adjustment declaration comparison not universal economic incompatibility.
Zero completed assessments does not suppress visible failure; content field included explicitly in finding signature.
